name: hugpy-wrapper
summary: The hugpy wrapper (import name: fitevict): a per-box evict-to-fit front door. An OpenAI /v1 server that resolves a called model to its weights (GGUF via llama.cpp, transformers chat/vision, and every non-chat engine: embeddings, whisper ASR, TTS, diffusers image + video, summarization, keywords), places it on the GPU by evicting what doesn't fit, serves it, and logs every call.
